description: The schema after open on an empty directory, read from sqlite_master with whitespace collapsed, plus user_version (0: the reference tracks its version in the kv row schema_version, which is read here too). Also checks that reopening changes nothing.

cases.name: a fresh database has the reference tables, indexes and version

objects.name: attachments_by_blob
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX attachments_by_blob ON attachments(blob_hash)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX checkpoints_by_workspace ON checkpoints(workspace_id, created_at DESC)

objects.sql: CREATE TABLE attachments ( message_row_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(row_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, position INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, blob_hash TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (message_row_id, position) )
